feeds.title: We Are Teachers
feeds.description: WeAreTeachers is more than a website, it is a proud community of educators - 3 million strong - who share ideas, resources, and stories of the amazing things happening in classrooms around the country. Our mission is to promote innovation in education through collaboration and connection to the most effective classroom resources.

feeds.title: Cool Cat Teacher Blog
feeds.description: The Cool Cat Teacher Blog helps you be an excellent educator every day with advice, ideas, and inspiration. Authored by Vicki Davis, a full-time teacher. Vicki has years of experience teaching teachers how to use technology in the classroom.

feeds.title: TeachThought
feeds.description: TeachThought is an educational platform founded in 2012 that focuses on innovation in K-12 education. It aims to foster innovative teaching through thought leadership, professional development, resource curation, and curriculum development. The platform collaborates globally to support educators and improve learning outcomes, offering content like blog posts, eBooks, podcasts, and online courses. TeachThought also works on developing 21st-century curricula and educational tools through various partnerships.

feeds.title: Teacher Toolkit Blog
feeds.description: The Most Influential Blog on Education in the UK. Blogging since 2000 and teaching since 1992, Ross McGill created this site to share his thoughts and resources that are meaningful for any classroom across the world.

feeds.title: Toronto Teacher Mom
feeds.description: Diana is a mother of two children and works as an elementary French teacher in Toronto, Ontario. Launched in 2006, her blog Toronto Teacher Mom features articles on technology, education, local events, resources for teachers, and more.

feeds.title: Teaching Made Practical Blog
feeds.description: Activities, ideas, resources, freebies, and more to help you teach more effectively while protecting your time. Authored by Kalena Baker who helps upper elementary teachers (3rd, 4th, 5th grade) save time and teach difficult skills in a practical, low prep way.

feeds.title: John Spencer Blog
feeds.description: I'm John Spencer, a former middle school teacher and current full-time professor who is passionate about seeing teachers empower their students with voice & choice. Here, I explore research, interview educators, deconstruct systems, and study real-world examples of design thinking in action.

feeds.title: TeacherCast
feeds.description: TeacherCast is designed for both the seasoned teacher who is searching for some great resources as well as the teacher who is unsure how to start incorporating newly developed 21st Century skills. Jeffrey Bradbury is here to share edtech news, updates, tutorials, and the latest apps that are driving today's classrooms.

feeds.title: New Action UFT
feeds.description: New Action is the oldest opposition caucus (political party) in the United Federation of Teachers, in existence since the mid 1980's (and forerunners since the mid-1970's). New Action is composed of members of the United Federation of Teachers who are or were teachers, paraprofessionals, secretaries, guidance counselors and members of the School Based Support Team. Many members have served on the UFT's Executive Board. The New Action blog publishes perspectives on policies affecting UFT members.

feeds.title: Teaching & Being Blog
feeds.description: Read about creative ideas to help educators approach their work with energy and passion. Blog author Suzanne Caines has been teaching high school English in public school settings in New Jersey for over 35 years. Her blog, Teaching & Being explores a wide range of topics, both professional and personal, that impact educators. She is particularly interested in the ways that mindfulness and joy can impact pedagogy and practice, and ultimately help teachers to become highly engaged and effective in their work.

feeds.title: What I Have Learned
feeds.description: Elementary teaching resources to enhance your classroom instruction. Math, science, social studies, reading, and classroom management ideas for teachers. Written by Jessica Boschen, an elementary teacher.

feeds.title: Imagination Soup Blog
feeds.description: Imagination Soup, curated by Melissa Taylor, serves as a hub for parents, librarians, and educators seeking great books and educational resources. As a mom, teacher, and literacy advocate, Melissa's expertise shines through her blog. With a background in education and freelance writing for prestigious clients like Random House and Scholastic, she champions literacy and representation in children's literature. Imagination Soup fosters a vibrant community dedicated to high-quality education and children's literacy.

feeds.title: Faculty Focus
feeds.description: Effective teaching strategies for the college classroom, both face-to-face and online. Topics covered are Educational Assessment, Teaching with Technology, Classroom Management, and Faculty Development. Faculty Focus is an online publication dedicated to effective teaching strategies for the college classroom.

feeds.title: Autism Classroom Resources Blog
feeds.description: Christine Reeve shares autism resources and tips for the classroom, homeschooling, and virtual learning. Her goal is to develop strategies and materials to provide meaningful and practical support to teachers and caregivers of individuals with autism spectrum disorder and other related disorders.

feeds.title: Cassie Stephens Blog
feeds.description: An elementary art teacher blog with art projects and lessons, DIY projects and outfit photos as well as clothing I have made myself. Authored by Cassie Stephens.

feeds.title: The Applicious Teacher Blog
feeds.description: The Applicious Teacher is a blog by Leigh Langton, an experienced Florida educator who shares creative, hands-on teaching ideas for 2nd grade. Her blog focuses on reading, writing, math, and classroom organization, offering practical lessons and tips to make learning engaging and easy to implement for young students.

feeds.title: Moffatt Girls
feeds.description: Fun and effective educational math and literacy resources to help students and teachers of preschool. Annie Moffatt is a stay-at-home mom, wife, and former elementary school teacher.

feeds.title: Two Writing Teachers
feeds.description: Stacey Shubitz is the Chief of Operations and Lead Writer for Two Writing Teachers. 'Two Writing Teachers' is a place for teachers to be fueled with a passion for teaching, writing, and living.

feeds.title: Resourceaholic
feeds.description: Ideas and resources for teaching secondary school mathematics. With everything from Star Wars puzzles to mathematical handwriting, it's an award-winning blog for all things maths. Written by Jo Morgan, a Maths Teacher.

feeds.title: Class Tech Tips Blog
feeds.description: Class Tech Tips is an EdTech Blog that helps teachers & schools discover new and innovative ways to use technology in their classrooms. Author Monica Burns writes about Reading & Writing Tools, VR Technology, and Assessment Tools.

feeds.title: 1+1+1=1 Blog
feeds.description: 1+1+1=1 is owned and written by me, Carisa Hinson. If you are a parent, a homeschooler, a classroom teacher, or anyone who works with children - you are in the right place! At 1Plus1Plus1Equals1, Carisa Hinson offers printables to use in the classroom.

feeds.title: Teacher Tom
feeds.description: A blog about teaching and learning from preschoolers. Thomas Hobson is a preschool teacher & author of Teacher Tom's First Book. He is inspired by the idea of helping thousands of educators to take their financial futures into their own hands almost as much as the idea of creating thousands of high-quality preschools.

feeds.title: From the Pond
feeds.description: A blog by Melanie Lloyd (From the Pond) about classroom activities and printables for K-3 learners: the mission is to provide motivating and practical teaching resources to teachers and parents of primary school-aged children. The aim of this blog is to make learning fun with bright, happy, skill-focused K-3 classroom printables!

feeds.title: Organized Classroom Blog
feeds.description: The Organized Classroom Blog is dedicated to those teachers who are or wish to be more efficient and effective in the K-12 classroom. It offers ideas, product reviews, and fun ideas for how to be more organized in the classroom!

feeds.title: English Teacher
feeds.description: A blog for EFL students in a friendly atmosphere. Subscribe to get the latest updates from this blog.

feeds.title: The Nerdy Teacher
feeds.description: An Educational Technology Blog that focuses on integrating tech into the classroom. Nicholas Provenzano also provide professional development for school districts.

feeds.title: Lisa Nielsen
feeds.description: A blog to share ideas about innovative, real, and relevant learning. Lisa Nielsen is the face behind this modern blog. She writes for and speaks to audiences across the globe about the future of education.

feeds.title: The Scholarly Teacher
feeds.description: The Scholarly Teacher emphasizes the importance of taking an informed and practiced approach to enhancing student learning by improving effective teaching.

feeds.title: Eduwonk
feeds.description: Education News, Analysis, and Commentary. Eduwonk is a blog written by Andrew J. Rotherham, that mainly focuses on education policy & politics. Eduwonk is a blog written by Andrew J. Rotherham, Co-founder and Partner at Bellwether Education Partners. The blog focuses mostly on education policy and politics.

feeds.title: The Whiteboard Blog
feeds.description: An educational blog that looks at the use of technology in the classroom - mainly Interactive Whiteboards or resources that work well on them. Also, find CPD for interactive whiteboards and other educational technology including iPads, & Android Tablets. Written by Danny Nicholson.

feeds.title: Teacher by the Beach
feeds.description: Welcome to Jen's blog where all her passion comes together, she is a girl who loves teaching. She is a first grade teacher teaching in sunshine state.

feeds.title: ICTEvangelist Blog
feeds.description: Award-winning blogger, author, & speaker Mark Anderson combines his knowledge of technology & teaching to share his passion for learning & tech innovation. Drawing on his experience as an assistant headteacher, Mark uses his blog to give classroom advice for educators, app ideas to encourage learning, and personal anecdotes.

feeds.title: The Jose Vilson Blog
feeds.description: Jose Vilson is a math educator, activist, father, and author of This Is Not A Test. This blog community consists of educators, activists, and intelligent allies from all walks of life. They respect the points of view of others, and try to find progress and positivity in a major way.

feeds.title: Special 2 Me
feeds.description: This blog is about a wife/daughter/mother/sister/friend who happens to be a Special Education Resource Specialist Teacher. You'll get the adventures of a special Ed teacher and inspirational ideas to teach better. Articles cover Anecdotes, Book Reviews, Parenting, and Random Thoughts.

feeds.title: Katie Martin Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Katie Martin is the author of Learner-Centered Innovation and VP of Leadership and Learning at Altitude Learning. She aspires to create experiences that empower all learners to develop the knowledge, skills, and mindsets to thrive in a changing world.

feeds.title: Teacherhead
feeds.description: Written by Tom Sherrington, a head teacher and teacher in London, this site explores contemporary ideas in teaching and learning and school leadership. He writes about everything from ideas for teaching to grading lessons.

feeds.title: First Grade Blue Skies - Now soaring in Kindergarten Blog
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to making learning fun. Jennifer White tries to provide ideas and feeebies for teachers along with great packs on TPT!

feeds.title: A Year of Reading
feeds.description: A blog by Two teachers (Franki Sibberson & Mary Lee) who read A lot. They have been teachers for more than 20 years. Through this blog, they discuss books and reading.

feeds.title: Time 4 Kindergarten
feeds.description: A kindergarten blog for kindergarten teachers. Sharing math, literacy, language arts, common core, and more. Also find ideas to teach reading, math, sight word recognition, and classroom organization.

feeds.title: Joanne Jacobs Blog
feeds.description: Free thinking and linking on education by Joanne Jacobs. Through this blog, she brings up stories that are relevant to all people involved in education and posts articles that can be helpful in a classroom.

feeds.title: thinkdotlearn
feeds.description: The thoughts on learning and education from Tim Manson. I'm wiritng a book about education - so some of my thoughts and ideas might appear here!

feeds.title: Musing Mathematically Blog
feeds.description: Nat Banting is a full-time classroom mathematics teacher in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada. He also works as a mathematics education lecturer in the Department of Curriculum Studies at the University of Saskatchewan.

feeds.title: Runde's Room | An educational blog
feeds.description: Jen is a grade school teacher and is passionate about teaching and sharing her upper grade classroom ideas and resources here on her blog. Jen loves creating engaging, fun, and rigorous activities for her students that keep learning fun, especially in literacy, math and the arts. Jen`s blog is full of ideas and is engaging for instructors of all kinds!

feeds.title: The Hungry Teacher Blog
feeds.description: Features middle school grammar, reading, writing, ELA planning, and organization. Martina Cahill is Middle School ELA teacher committed to helping you improve your teaching & implement systems that help you get everything done during the school day.

feeds.title: Word Dancer: Literature, the Arts, & Education Blog
feeds.description: My blog is Word Dancer: Literature, the Arts, & Education: Exploring curiosity, imagination, and wonder. It covers an eclectic range of topics and centers around reading, writing, making art, playful learning, and above all - CURIOSITY.

feeds.title: Educational Innovations Blog | Teachers Serving Teachers!
feeds.description: Your resource for Science and STEM classroom learning tools, lab supplies, and fun science experiments. As science teachers ourselves, we recognize the importance of motivating students of all ages and engaging them in the process of learning!

feeds.title: ExpertEase Education Blog
feeds.description: A 100% Online Educational Academy that Provides Unique and Premium Quality Educational Material in the Form of Courses and Support Services to help learners from Various Backgrounds acquire knowledge that can help them in their day-to-day life! Our Mission since the inception of the academy is to provide High Caliber Courses that actually make a difference not just educate theoretically but bridge the gap between Theory and Application.

feeds.title: Kevin's Meandering Mind
feeds.description: Kevin is a sixth-grade teacher and a teacher-consultant of the Western Massachusetts Writing Project. Through this blog, he covers a lot of ground - from teaching to writing, to music, to art, and beyond.

feeds.title: The Kitchen Table Classroom
feeds.description: I'm Jodi, your art teacher! I'm passionate about art education for kids. I want to provide you with art projects for kids, printable kid's crafts to inspire your kid's creativity! I hope you'll find some inspiration at the Kitchen Table Classroom.

feeds.title: Shelley Gray Teaching
feeds.description: Teaching in the Early Years is a blog written by mom & teacher, Shelley Gray. She is on a mission to help your students feel successful & engaged. Here, teachers & parents can find valuable teaching resources, ideas, and reflections from an early years perspective.

feeds.title: Fun In First
feeds.description: A Teaching Blog by Jodi Southard. Jodi is a 1st-grade teacher from Terre Haute, Indiana. Through this blog, she strives to make learning fun, practical, and rigorous for all students. Her goal is to make things that are easy to prep and can take some of the stress off of you as a teacher.

feeds.title: Kinder Craze
feeds.description: A Kindergarten Teaching Blog by Maria Gavin. The Kinder-Craze blog is loaded with ideas & inspiration for classroom teachers and features content & crafts for toddlers & preschoolers. You'll also find printable classroom activities and instructional decor.

feeds.title: Teaching Heart Blog
feeds.description: A place for teachers and parents with a teaching heart! Colleen Gallagher created this site to share teaching ideas, printables, inspiration, links, lessons, units, activity sheets, and so much more.

feeds.title: David Didau | The Learning Spy
feeds.description: Brain food for the thinking teacher. Over the past 15 years, David Didau has worked with hundreds of schools in the UK & overseas. He leads bespoke training & provides consultancy on a wide range of topics including behaviour management, education research, whole-school literacy, curriculum design and more.

feeds.title: Nik's Learning Technology Blog
feeds.description: A blog about the use of educational technology in language learning and teaching. Follow to get all the latest ideas, apps, and teaching resources to keep your students engaged.

feeds.title: Alice in Methodologyland
feeds.description: Focused on teachers who teach English as a second language to young and very young learners. Here, you'll find methodological articles, how-to's, lesson recordings, examples, activities, reflections of professional development, and ESL materials.

feeds.title: Kathy Schrock's Kaffeeklatsch
feeds.description: An informal gathering to drink coffee and chat. Author Kathy Schrock posts thoughts, discoveries, and ideas here, primarily on educational technology topics and gadgets. Kathy is a school district Director of Technology, and a middle school, academic, museum, and public library librarian.

feeds.title: Peas in a Pod Lessons
feeds.description: The teacher created resources, ideas, lessons, and step-by-step directions. Teaching since 2004, the author proudly creates teaching resources in an effort to make teaching less overwhelming.

feeds.title: Angela Maiers Blog
feeds.description: One of the most useful blogs around, Angela presents tons of information that can literally be taken into the classroom the very next day. Angela works with schools & organizations on igniting change and spreading hope through the science & practice of mattering.

feeds.title: What the Teacher Wants!
feeds.description: Tips for teachers, parents, and anyone in between! What the Teacher Wants was started in 2010 as a way for Rachelle to post pictures of her classroom and share her teaching ideas.

feeds.title: misscalcul8
feeds.description: A brand new teacher, Miss Cal.Q.L8 is learning how to do the whole education thing. Her blog is a reflection of that, and it's going to be fun to watch her grow through the next few years.

feeds.title: Teacher Gems | Websites For Elementary Students
feeds.description: Teacher Gems is a collection of teaching resources and websites for elementary students. Find the best writing centers for elementary students as well as special education resources and more.

feeds.title: Miss D the Teacher | NZ Teacher Blog
feeds.description: Danielle Myburgh's learning journey in education and teaching: all things e-learning,mathematics, science, pedagogy and the adventures in my new school.

feeds.title: Creative Connections For Kids by Kristi Delp
feeds.description: Kristi Delp is the coordinator and parent educator for Parents as Teachers (PAT) and the manager of this blog. Equipped with a master's degree in early childhood special education and 20 years of experience, she shares valuable advice and insight on everything from fun family recipes and parenting tips to games and activities that develop motor skills.

feeds.title: 140 Learning
feeds.description: Stepan Pruchnicky's professional learning. Thoughts that take more than 140 characters to express.

feeds.title: Rescue the teacher, Save the child
feeds.description: A Blog by Paula Baack. Thank you for visiting my blog! I hope you find it entertaining and insightful. Whether you are a new or seasoned teacher, a parent, an administrator, or you are curious about teacher issues, this blog is for you.

feeds.title: Herding Kats in Kindergarten
feeds.description: Sharing ideas, tips and freebies as I document my days Herding Kats In Kindergarten.

feeds.title: Primary Graffiti
feeds.description: This beautifully designed blog is a great resource for teachers who work in looping classrooms or who are responsible for teaching several different grades throughout the day. Classroom ideas and lesson plans are presented alongside management tips.

feeds.title: The Health Teacher Blog
feeds.description: I teach Middle School Health at the Shanghai American School and have a passion for curriculum that is current, relevant, adaptable, and shared. Follow this blog to get the best health guide online.

feeds.title: Rockstar Math Teacher
feeds.description: Rockstar Math Teacher is the 8th Grade Common Core middle school math teacher. Subscribe to this blog and get the latest updates.

feeds.title: DyKnow
feeds.description: Helpful articles, webinars, and resources curated by the Dyknow team with Teachers, Tech Coaches, and Administrators in mind. Dyknow is a classroom management software that aids student device monitoring that works for in-person, remote, and hybrid learning.

feeds.title: dy/dan Blog
feeds.description: Dan who is a former high school math teacher updates on innovations, ideas, and news in math teaching. Dan Meyer has a solid blog that appeals to both his inner nerd as well as the greedy little kid who wants something he can take and apply.

feeds.title: Fairy Dust Teaching
feeds.description: A passionate early childhood educator who loves sharing ideas with teachers, homeschooling families, and people in the arts! Fairy Dust Teaching provides inspiration and training for honoring young children through play-based learning.

feeds.title: The Happy Teacher
feeds.description: Teaching resources, activities, games, classroom management, organization tools & worksheets for the K-2 classroom. Authored by Liz, a former elementary school teacher who loves sharing teaching tips through her blog posts.

feeds.title: BookWidgets Blog
feeds.description: A blog from BookWidgets for teachers. We write about technology for the classroom, fun facts about students, and creative lesson ideas. BookWidgets is an educational tool that enables teachers to make interactive exercises and automatically graded tests.

feeds.title: The Daring English Teacher Blog
feeds.description: Christina, The Daring English Teacher, is a full-time high school English teacher, wife, & mother. With more than a decade of teaching experience, she focuses on providing engaging & differentiated learning experiences to her students and the educational community.

feeds.title: George Couros Blog
feeds.description: The latest updates on innovation, leadership, and learning by George Couros. George is the author of 'The Innovator's Mindset' & 'Innovate Inside the Box' and has worked at all school levels, from K-12 as a teacher, technology facilitator, and school and district administrator.

feeds.title: Educational Technology Guy
feeds.description: Free resources for teachers, educational ideas & tips, educational topics, Personal Learning Networks, Project Based Learning, Google, Evernote, and Discovery Education. Authored by David Andrade, an experienced engineer, school district CIO, and Google administrator who works with organizations to set up, deploy & manage their Google Workspace & Chrome projects.

feeds.title: The Master Teacher Blog
feeds.description: Developing, Supporting, and Honoring Educators since 1969.

feeds.title: Classwork.com
feeds.description: Free Technology for Teachers provides teachers with ideas for using free technology resources in their classrooms. It is created by Richard Byrne as part of the PD course that Richard took with the Great Maine Schools partnership.

feeds.title: Ladybug's Teacher Files
feeds.description: Ladybug's Teacher Files is a 5th-grade teaching blog & resource collection sharing tips & tricks to save time in the classroom. Here, you'll find Classroom Decor, Organization, Lessons and Activities, Technology Tips, and Free Files.

feeds.title: Magical Maths
feeds.description: Magical Maths is a fun and friendly site that was set up in early 2007 to act as a learning hub for teachers around the world. The site receives thousands of visits per day and has developed into an influential educational site where educators across the globe share resources and strategies.

feeds.title: Teacher Tapp
feeds.description: A great source of CPD for teachers, useful insights that can improve teaching practice, and data showcasing educators' thoughts and opinions. Teacher Tapp is a daily survey app where thousands of teachers answer daily questions so their collective opinions can be heard and used to inform school leaders, media, policymakers, and organizations creating products for schools.

feeds.title: A Place Called Kindergarten
feeds.description: A blog about a Kindergarten classroom. Author Jonelle Bell spends her days with five and six-year-old readers, writers, mathematicians and scientist and love watching them learn and grow.

feeds.title: Kleinspiration Connecting Tradition and Technology
feeds.description: The face of this blog is Erin Klein. She's an award-winning educator, national keynote speaker, author and mother. Her blog covers almost everything. From fun and useful tools to handy teacher tips and learning advice.

feeds.title: Successful Teaching
feeds.description: Tons of links and information that is directly applicable to use in the classroom. Ideas and strategies for new and struggling teachers.

feeds.title: NYC Educator By Arthur Goldstein
feeds.description: Arthur Goldstein is an ESL teacher and UFT Chapter Leader at Francis Lewis High School.

feeds.title: Irish Primary Teacher
feeds.description: Advice, Support, and Resources for teachers in Ireland. Niamh Byrne is the author and creator of Irish Primary Teacher which is a website for primary school teachers in Ireland. She set up this website to keep track of new ideas while teaching in the UK.

feeds.title: MusTech
feeds.description: MusTEch.Net is one of the longest standing blogs about Music Education and Music Technology and the home of Dr. Joseph M. Pisano and Amy M. Burns.

feeds.title: The French Corner
feeds.description: A blog for French teachers by Samantha Decker, a French teacher in upstate New York. Learn about resources, lesson plan ideas, and interact with other French teachers.
